evals.name: community-post-process-before-product
evals.prompt: write the free community post for this week's lesson: why couples pick the DJ who runs the night, not the one with the best playlist. plain text for skool, sells the process not the how, soft bridge to premium. accelerator is on waitlist so any CTA is the free community
evals.expected_output: Plain-text Skool post: reframe in the opener, the process sold (why one voice runs the night) with the how held back, question-led section lines, closing question answerable without the how, premium link placeholder, sign-off, no dashes.

evals.name: sales-page-section-two-sales
evals.prompt: write the section of the DJ MOJOE weddings page that comes right after the hero. it has to get a couple bought into why a reception is run by one voice before the page ever makes the case for Joe. facts only from the registry, no dashes
evals.expected_output: A section that sells the process (first sale) before the product, describes the couple's situation better than they could, uses a reframe as the headline and question-phrased subheads, cites only registry facts, names no doubt the reader did not raise.

evals.name: blog-outline-question-h2s
evals.prompt: outline a WDJM blog post titled why your consult should never start with price. give me the H2s, a two-sentence intro, and the one belief each section installs. free community CTA at the end
evals.expected_output: Question-phrased H2s that each answer the question the previous section raised, one belief per section, intro states the single belief, CTA to the free community, no dashes.

evals.name: reel-wired-writer
evals.prompt: write me a reel I can read off the teleprompter, 60 to 90 seconds, about why 'we just want everyone to have a good time' should worry a DJ on a consult, not comfort them. working wedding DJs. accelerator on waitlist so CTA is the free community
evals.expected_output: wdjm-script-writer format block plus clean teleprompter text: reframe connected to the DJ's belief, one-word thesis or reframe hook, self-questions between beats, one attention generator, belief before CTA, spoken-script pass clean.
